rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when the doorkeeper is a security guard at a building or entrance.

example.english: The doorkeeper asked me to show my staff ID before I could go in.
example.traditional: 保安叫我出示職員證先可以入去。
example.jyutping: bou2 on1 giu3 ngo5 ceot1 si6 zik1 jyun4 zing3 sin1 ho2 ji5 jap6 heoi3

rows.note: Use this more exact term for a person formally assigned to guard a gate or entryway.

example.english: The doorkeeper stood beside the main gate and checked everyone’s admission ticket.
example.traditional: 門衛企喺大閘旁邊，逐個檢查入場證。
example.jyutping: mun4 wai6 kei5 hai2 daai6 zaap6 pong4 bin1 zuk6 go3 gim2 caa4 jap6 coeng4 zing3

rows.note: Use this for a doorkeeper or gatehouse attendant in an institution or older-style setting.

example.english: That old school still has a doorkeeper who opens the main gate every morning.
example.traditional: 呢間舊學校仲有門房，每朝負責開大閘。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gau6 hok6 haau6 zung6 jau5 mun4 fong4 mui5 ziu1 fu6 zaak3 hoi1 daai6 zaap6
